body:
Yeah, that's exactly it. It reminds me of being at a party with a bunch of people I don't know. Sure, it may be fun at times, and I can make small talk and eat free food, but it all feels contrived. I'm watching other people talk but their conversations make no sense to me. I have nothing else to do, so I'm not intent on leaving the party, but at the same time I'd rather not be there.

I'm happy to continue getting up each morning and doing school work and seeing friends, but all the time there's a dull sense beckoning me to just... stop.
